## Findings
- [ ] **[WARN][Security] zizmor code scanning alerts (CI workflow pinning)**
  - **Status quo:** 13 open alerts from `zizmor` (GitHub Actions security linter): cache-poisoning risk in `release.yml` setup-go step, unpinned `golang/govulncheck-action@v1.1.0` in `ci.yml`, and ref-version-mismatch/artipacked issues across workflows.
  - **Likely cause:** Workflow actions not fully SHA-pinned; setup-go cache not hardened.
  - **Proposed solution:** Run `zizmor` fix suggestions and pin remaining actions to SHA hashes.
  - **Handoff:** `/05-gh-security-fix` or manual fix in `.github/workflows/`

- [ ] **[WARN][Coverage] No coverage threshold configured**
  - **Status quo:** No `fail_under` or CI coverage gate exists. Current coverage 82.7% is above 80% default baseline but untracked.
  - **Likely cause:** First meaningful release; coverage infrastructure not yet set up.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add coverage measurement and a soft gate in CI for future iterations.
  - **Handoff:** `/test-coverage` → `/02-gh-plan --from-coverage`
